Package pl.rentathing.user.service

Class UserService

java.lang.Object
pl.rentathing.user.service.UserService
@Service @Transactional public class UserService extends Object
Service class responsible for managing users in the system. This class provides methods for retrieving, updating, and managing user entities. It uses the UserRepository for database interactions and PasswordEncoder for password encoding.

    • searchUsers

      public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<UserListDTO> searchUsers(String search, String role, String status, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Searches for users based on the provided filters such as search query, role, and status. If no filters are provided, it returns all users.
      Parameters:
      search - A string used to search for users based on their attributes (e.g., name, email).
      role - The role of the users to search for, specified as a string. If "ALL" or invalid, no role filters are applied.
      status - The status filter of the users. It can be "active", "inactive", or "blocked". If null, no status filters are applied.
      pageable - The pagination and sorting information.
      Returns:
      A page of UserListDTO objects that match the search criteria.

    • updateUserSettings

      public void updateUserSettings(Long userId, UserSettingsDTO settingsDTO)
      Updates the settings of a user by their ID.
      Parameters:
      userId - The unique identifier of the user whose settings need to be updated.
      settingsDTO - An object containing the user's updated settings, including personal information, notification preferences, password, and address.
      Throws:
      UserNotFoundException - If a user with the given ID is not found.
      InvalidPasswordException - If the provided current password is missing or does not match the user's existing password when attempting to update the password.

    • blockUser

      public void blockUser(Long userId)
      Blocks a user by setting their account as locked. This method retrieves the user by their ID, throws an exception if the user is not found, and updates their locked status.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user to be blocked
